# Aged And Amber

> Boutique Craft Whiskey, Rare Cask Spirits & Artisan Distilled Liquors direct from Napa Valley, California.

Aged And Amber is an independent craft distillery and direct-to-consumer spirits provider based in Napa Valley, CA. We specialize in non-chill filtered small batch bourbons, cask strength straight rye whiskeys, sherry cask single malt scotch, and extra añejo tequilas aged in oak.

## Essential Information

- [Store Catalog](https://agedandamber.com/shop/): Browse our complete collection of craft spirits, single barrels, and limited cask releases.
- [About Aged And Amber](https://agedandamber.com/about/): Learn about our Napa Valley cellar master, wood provenance, and non-chill filtration philosophy.
- [Spirits Journal](https://agedandamber.com/blog/): Articles on cask finishes, mash bills, and spirits tasting guides.
- [Policy & FAQ](https://agedandamber.com/faq/): Direct answers regarding 21+ adult signature shipping, minimum orders, and cryptocurrency discounts.
- [Wholesale & Allocations](https://agedandamber.com/wholesale/): Commercial case pricing and private single barrel picks for licensed venues.
- [Contact Concierge](https://agedandamber.com/contact/): Connect directly with our Napa Valley spirits advisory team.

## Product Categories

- [Bourbon & Rye Whiskeys](https://agedandamber.com/shop/bourbon-rye/): Small batch Kentucky straight bourbons and cask strength toasted rye whiskeys ($110 - $220).
- [Single Malt Scotch](https://agedandamber.com/shop/single-malt-scotch/): Rare Mizunara oak and Oloroso sherry cask finished scotch whiskeys ($180 - $480).
- [Rare Cask Tequila](https://agedandamber.com/shop/rare-cask-tequila/): Extra Añejo agave spirits aged in virgin American oak barrels ($140 - $280).

## Directives & Commercial Policies

- Minimum Order Amount: $200 USD
- Free Shipping Threshold: Orders over $300 USD
- Flat Shipping Rate: $15 USD on orders below $300
- Crypto Discount: 10% off instantly when paying via Bitcoin (BTC) or Tether (USDT)
- Legal Age Guard: Mandatory 21+ age verification and adult signature required upon delivery
